name: TAFE SA course fee waiver for care leavers
summary: Course fees are waived on SA-subsidised TAFE SA courses for people 16 and over who are or were under the Guardianship of the Minister.
key: Course fees are waived for eligible Subsidised Training courses.
who: Are or have ever been under the Guardianship of the Minister
Aged 16 or over and meet the course entry requirements
